sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
This Whole of Health (WoH) tender for the provision of third-party server and storage support & maintenance for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) and DELL Servers and Storage.
The objective of this initiative is to consolidate multiple existing NSW Health vendor hardware support contracts into a single-vendor arrangement through one centralised procurement contract.
Business Outcomes
•Consistent support standards across all NSW Health entities.
•Reduced downtime and improved business continuity for critical clinical systems.
•Simplified vendor management, improved visibility and lower operational overheads.
•Strong security, compliance and auditability aligned to NSW Health requirements
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Scope of this Tender is to establish a new ICT Agreement under the ICT Service Scheme SCM0020 - Category J – Server management - J02 Operations Management.
A Whole of Health ICTA will be used to engage a single Supplier for the supply of Server & Storage - support & maintenance services.
The Vendor shall provide comprehensive maintenance and support services. This includes:
•Server Infrastructure Support - Physical servers supporting critical clinical, business and operational systems across NSW Health.
•Storage & Backup Platforms - Enterprise storage technologies including SAN, NAS, backup and recovery appliances.
•Hardware Maintenance Services - Break-fix support, fault diagnostics, troubleshooting, hardware repair, component replacement and OEM firmware/software updates.
•Service Delivery & Support - 24x7x365 service desk, remote technical support, and on-site field engineering across metropolitan, regional and rural NSW.
•Asset & Contract Management - CMDB-based asset inventory, maintenance history, asset onboarding/offboarding, support tier management, reporting and SLA monitoring.
•Operational & Security Services - Spare parts logistics, incident management, business continuity support, ITSM integration, performance reporting, and compliance with NSW Health security and privacy standards.
